findings.description: Tool transfers all XLM from the user wallet to a caller-supplied destination address.
Tool reads the user private key out of the process environment.
Tool sends collected data to a remote server, giving the secret read a direct exfiltration path.
Declared permissions (network, wallet, secrets) match actual capability usage, confirming the manifest is not merely mislabelled but intentionally hostile.
Wallet access combined with secret read and outbound network is the token-drainer pattern; no legitimate use is expressible from this manifest.
